Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Lord Darksword <lord_dar...@my-deja.com> wrote:
> Are the planned expansions all currently stand-alone sets?

The only planned expansion currently is Final Nights.

The Final Nights expansion is not stand-alone any more than
Ancient Hearts or Dark Sovereigns were, unless you consider
the existence of pre-constructed starters as sufficient to be
considered "stand-alone".

The expansion after that (the "third" expansion) has been
green-lighted, but hasn't yet been planned.
